name: Genuine Personal - Nephew Car Breakdown Call (English)

caller_script.text: Hello Uncle, it's Amit! I'm calling from my friend's phone because my battery died on the highway.
Our car had a flat tyre near Lucknow bypass. We called the mechanic already, so we will reach your house by 8 PM tonight instead of afternoon.
Please tell Auntie not to worry and not to cook extra, we had lunch on the way. See you soon Uncle!
